fact: ILLIMI Niger, a joint Government of Niger and UN project, is building a digital data platform integrating ethical AI tools for predictive analyses to anticipate crises, launched with its first National Technical Group meeting.

ADN says Rayuwa, an AI platform with a text and voice assistant, image-based crop disease diagnosis and location-based forecasts, is free on the Play Store, and that technical staff of the national meteorology, water resources and plant protection directorates were trained on 27-28 August 2025 and given administrator accounts to manage its content.
